name: Aukett Swanke Group Plc
summary: Aukett Swanke Group Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated professional design services in the United Kingdom, the Middle East, and Continental Europe. The company's services comprise architectural design; interior design; master planning; executive architecture; related engineering services; and design for sustainability projects, heritage buildings, and adaptive reuse projects, as well as workplace strategy projects. It offers its services to property developers, owner occupiers, and governmental organizations. The company was formerly known as Aukett Fitzroy Robinson Group plc and changed its name to Aukett Swanke Group Plc in March 2014. Aukett Swanke Group Plc was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
